name: scdaw_design_sound
description: Configure a track in one call from a studio sound recipe ('dj-airhorn', 'reggae-siren', 'brass-stab', 'hoover-rave') with full synthesis parameters, per-track FX chain, and optional default musical pattern.

recipe.description: Sound design recipe or preset name

instrument.description: Optional instrument engine override (defaults to recipe's optimal engine, e.g. 'nano' for dj-airhorn)

fx.description: Optional custom FX chain array override

insertDefaultPattern.description: If true, writes the recipe's signature note pattern onto the track (e.g. 'wha-wha-wha-whaaaaaa' for dj-airhorn)
